matches.rationale: No report finding mentions the missing 128-byte account storage overhead in the minimum deposit rent calculation.
No report finding mentions the PDA bump being passed in as a user-supplied instruction argument.
Finding 9 is about the empty receiver/data in EtherBridge.deposit, not MessageSent emitting the Ethereum chain id as the destination.
No report finding mentions log truncation of outbox messages.
Finding 5 identifies that sendMessage stores the generated nonce in sendNonces without checking whether it was already used.
No report finding mentions that the addressArrayInitialized modifier accepts an empty array.
No report finding raises the design issue of the relayer account holding custody of all bridged funds.
No report finding mentions the missing _disableInitializers call on the implementation contracts.
No report finding mentions invoke_signed being used where plain invoke would suffice.
Finding 12 identifies the excessive fixed 1024-byte allocation for Configuration, which wastes rent.
